overview_description.description:
Lisan AI is an AI technology company focused on enhancing enterprise productivity through intelligent automation and multilingual AI solutions. The company develops advanced tools that streamline communication, optimize workflows, and improve operational efficiency for organizations across diverse industries.

Its flagship product, WriteX, is an AI-powered multilingual writing assistant that supports both Arabic and English. The platform provides grammar correction, style enhancement, intelligent autocompletion, and compliance checks, helping professionals create accurate, polished, and contextually appropriate content more efficiently.

MeetriX serves as an intelligent meeting assistant designed to improve collaboration and productivity through automated note-taking, real-time meeting analytics, and actionable insights. The solution enables organizations to capture discussions effectively, streamline follow-ups, and enhance decision-making processes.

In addition, NitroX offers AI-powered accelerators that automate complex document creation, chart generation, and workflow processes. By reducing manual effort and accelerating operational tasks, NitroX helps organizations improve efficiency, scalability, and overall productivity.

Together, Lisan AI’s suite of AI-driven enterprise tools empowers businesses to modernize communication, automate repetitive tasks, and build more intelligent, efficient digital workplaces.

about_short_description.short_description: Lisan AI provides multilingual AI-powered writing assistant, productivity tools, automation solutions for enterprises and governments.

product.name: Lisan AI Proofreading
product.description: An AI-powered tool that detects and corrects eight types of linguistic errors in Arabic and English texts, including spelling, grammar, morphology, semantics, names, and quotations.

product.name: Lisan Institutional Writing Accelerators
product.description: Advanced AI tools designed to enhance writing productivity and automate the application of an institution's approved writing style.

product.name: Lisan Performance Reports
product.description: A feature that monitors, evaluates, and reports on the performance of language use and proofreading activities within an organization.

product.name: Lisan Language Learning Tools
product.description: Educational tools that provide explanations of linguistic errors, grammar rules, and vocabulary to support Arabic language learning.

product.name: Lisan Browser and Application Extensions
product.description: Extensions and add-ons for browsers, Microsoft Office, WordPress, and desktop applications that integrate Lisan's proofreading and writing assistance capabilities.

product.name: Lisan API and SDK
product.description: APIs and software development kits that allow integration of Lisan's AI proofreading and writing tools into third-party applications and systems.
